title: Revert reject request
description: Owner decision RS-2 (basalt_meta version 23). The body of POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/reject, which the revert page sends under the link's current secret, on loopback or inside a Vault link session. No passkey: rejecting can only stop a revert. The engine calls basalt_meta.reject_revert, adding the scope token it holds for a widened revert's rotated link (after a widen Postgres refuses a reject without it), and revokes the link; the answer is 200 { "revertId", "status": "REJECTED", "rejectedAt" }. See CONTRACT.md, Revert, Rescope, widen and reject.

note.description: Optional, for the agent: the page says the agent will read it. Stored in the REVERT_REJECTED ledger row and returned in the agent's wait.
